none: PAS LIN-25CD0D: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver finger ring bearing the abbreviation 'TOT' on the bezel. The hoop is chunky, with broad shoulders and a raised circular bezel. The perimeter of the bezel is decorated with short incised lines. A lozenge-shaped raised panel is located on the circular bezel.
